run_boost_build_test_with_time_limit: run a BoostBuild test that verifies the -l flag enforces a 2 second time limit on build actions
write_test_file_with_tester: write a test file using BoostBuild.Tester.write to create a .jam file with sleep actions for testing
run_build_system_with_options: run the BoostBuild test system with flags like -ffile.jam -d1 -l2 to test time limit enforcement
expect_output_lines_for_test: expect specific output lines like '2 second time limit exceeded' to validate test behavior
cleanup_tester_after_test: cleanup the BoostBuild.Tester instance after running a test to remove temporary files
